summary: Policy templates + live hosting_accounts drive routing. Customer subdomains are not stored here — they are generated when accounts are active. Starman :3001 is LAN/ZT only.

dev_policy.rule: Every dev.{domain} is served by the workstation (Starman). Never production. Hostname policy only — never WAN DNAT of 3001.
dev_policy.hosts_note: Hosts file is optional. Devices without it use Unbound (DHCP DNS 192.168.1.1) or mDNS workstation.local. Remote devices without ZeroTier need a named HTTPS front door on 443, not a ZT IP in public DNS.
dev_policy.https_note: Do not orange-cloud dev.* at the public WAN IP:3001. LAN: http://dev.computersystemconsulting.ca/ via HAProxy :80. Remote without ZT: Tunnel+Access or HAProxy :443 with auth (work item). Until that exists, use LAN Unbound or ZeroTier names.

zero_naming.not: A single zero hostname on the OPNsense gateway IP
zero_naming.audience: ZeroTier members only. Not a substitute for public DNS or hosts-file-less remote access.

dns_precedence: LAN Unbound: specific dev beats wildcard *. dev.csc → gateway :80 (HAProxy → :3001). Other dev.* → workstation LAN :3001. Do not publish workstation ZT IPs in Cloudflare. Remote named access is a 443 front door (work item), not WAN:3001.

nameless_device_access.problem: Phones, tablets, and guest laptops have no /etc/hosts and often no ZeroTier. They still need a name to reach the app.
nameless_device_access.remote_without_zerotier: Named HTTPS on 443 with Access/IdP/client-cert, origin 192.168.1.199:3001 on LAN. Do not use public A=172.30.131.126 or WAN DNAT 3001.

provision_order: Cloudflare A record (public DNS for production names only — not workstation ZT, not :3001)
OPNsense Unbound (dev, apex, or non-wildcard zone) so LAN clients need no hosts file
HAProxy LAN :80 for dev.csc; production HTTPS on a separate frontend
OPNsense firewall LAN/ZT pass to workstation :3001 — never WAN DNAT of 3001
Remote 443 front door (Tunnel+Access) when clients have no ZT and no hosts file

policy_rules.label: Dev Comserv (must beat wildcard)
policy_rules.notes: Unbound → gateway :80; HAProxy (LAN frontend) forwards to workstation Starman :3001. No :3001 in the URL. No WAN publish of 3001.

policy_rules.label: Dev BeeMaster
policy_rules.notes: Unbound → workstation :3001 for LAN clients with no hosts file. Do not Cloudflare A this to ZT. Remote no-ZT access is the 443 front-door work item.

policy_rules.label: Production wildcard (CSC LAN)
policy_rules.notes: Shared prod subdomains (coop.csc, etc.) use this — no per-site Unbound row needed. Keep last (lowest precedence).

policy_rules.label: ZeroTier entry — CSC (overlay members)
policy_rules.notes: For ZeroTier members. Not the path for devices with no hosts file and no ZT.
